alerts.title: Acute Kidney Injury
alerts.message: Guidelines state to monitor creatinine in patients on TDF, especially during intercurrent illnesses with dehydration or sepsis. Patient has severe gastroenteritis with dehydration and acute kidney injury (creatinine 2.4, was 0.9). TDF may be a contributing factor, but dehydration and sepsis are also likely causes.

evidence.recommended_action: Stop TDF temporarily and recheck creatinine after IV fluid resuscitation
